references.text: The continuation of the account of Joshua's inheritance, where he receives the city of Timnath-Serah as his possession
Joshua was buried in his inherited portion at Timnath-Serah, confirming that he received this inheritance
Joshua son of Nun is mentioned as one of the leaders appointed to distribute the land
Joshua son of Nun is one of the two spies who were promised entry into the land
Parallel to Caleb's inheritance, where he also received a special portion after the distribution of the land was completed
Refers back to the fact that Joshua son of Nun died after receiving his inheritance
